articles.title: NESN extends contract of longtime studio and play-by-play voice Tom Caron
articles.description:
NESN announced Wednesday that it has extended its contract with longtime studio and play-by-play voice Tom Caron. Caron, a 13-time New England Emmy Award winner, has been with the network since 1995. His current duties include hosting Red Sox pre- and postgame programming, NESN’s baseball podcast “310 to Left,” and calling Beanpot and Hockey East […]
